## Last-checked: 2026-09-23

# Um:bruch

Canonical organization: https://github.com/um-bruch
Website: https://um-bruch.org
Projects page: https://um-bruch.org/projekte/
Repository purpose: GitHub organization profile, community context, and machine-readable index for Um:bruch.
Public active repository count: 6 total (5 research and software repositories plus 1 central organization profile).
Public profile repository: https://github.com/um-bruch/.github

Um:bruch is an independent think tank and development lab for health-system analysis, statutory prescribing transparency, rare-disease pathway logic, open research materials, and local-first public-interest software prototypes.

## Audience

Researchers, health-policy professionals, medical informatics specialists, civic-tech developers, and public-interest readers looking for open analysis, reproducible research material, and local-first software prototypes in the areas of healthcare systems, diagnostics, and civic technology.

## Primary Public Repositories

- https://github.com/um-bruch/verordnungsampel
  Local-first prescribing compliance & budget traffic-light system for statutory health insurance in Germany. Validates ICD-10-GM / ATC pairs against AM-RL, G-BA decisions, PRISCUS 2.0, and Heilmittelkatalog budgets. Python 3.10+, PySide6, SQLite, PWA companion. Last public push: 2026-09-20.

- https://github.com/um-bruch/locuterra
  Open-source concept and interactive Next.js demonstrator for a public-interest, location-based civic social network and digital commons for municipalities with synthetic district demo data (Grüntal). TypeScript, React, Next.js, TailwindCSS, PWA. Last public push: 2026-08-25.

- https://github.com/um-bruch/system-medicine
  Research-only functional pathway medical knowledge graph prototype for rare-disease differential diagnosis, pathway exclusion logic, biomedical graph reasoning, and healthcare research software. Python 3.10+, PySide6, SQLite, NetworkX. Permanent DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20101507. Last public push: 2026-08-21.

- https://github.com/um-bruch/multiaxial-diagnostic-system
  Research-use-only 6-axis psychiatric documentation prototype referencing DSM-5-TR, ICD-11, ICF, HiTOP, TeX documentation, Streamlit workspace, and Flask screening testcenter; not a medical device. Permanent DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18736725. Last public push: 2026-08-05.

- https://github.com/um-bruch/regressangst
  Working-paper and concept material on Regressangst, statutory prescribing-audit recourse anxiety, healthcare policy transparency, and the PP-003 Regress portal concept in the German healthcare system. Last public push: 2026-07-27.

- https://github.com/um-bruch/.github
  Organization profile, public repository directory, community health files, automated parity test suite, and machine-readable llms.txt context for search systems and LLM crawlers. Last public push: 2026-09-23.

## Positioning & Guardrails

- Public-interest research, health-policy analysis, and civic-tech prototypes.
- Open-source code and open research material under OSI/CC BY licenses where appropriate.
- Research, analysis, and concept work, not medical advice or certified medical devices under EU MDR (2017/745) or BfArM regulations.
- German-first research and regulatory context with English metadata for international discoverability.
- Strict local-first architecture without cloud dependencies or telemetric data leakage.
